definitions.explanation: Physically facing or oriented toward the back.
Having a negative or passive attitude toward something. The opposite of {前向|まえむ}き (positive, forward-looking).

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きに{座|すわ}る。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きの{姿勢|しせい}で{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: He was standing with his back turned.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きに{倒|たお}れた。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{考|かんが}え{方|かた}はやめよう。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{発言|はつげん}が{多|おお}い。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{態度|たいど}では{何|なに}も{変|か}わらない。
examples.english: Nothing will change with a negative attitude.

notes:
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き has both a physical meaning (facing backward) and a figurative meaning (pessimistic, negative). The figurative sense is more commonly used in everyday conversation.

USAGE:
Can function as both a noun and a na-adjective:
- Na-adjective: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{態度|たいど} (a negative attitude)
- Adverb: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きに{考|かんが}える (to think negatively)
The {向|む}き pattern is productive: {前向|まえむ}き (forward), {横向|よこむ}き (sideways), {上向|うわむ}き (upward), {下向|したむ}き (downward).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{考|かんが}え{方|かた}: negative thinking
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{発言|はつげん}: pessimistic remarks
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな{態度|たいど}: passive/negative attitude
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きに{倒|たお}れる: to fall backward (physical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前向|まえむ}き: forward-looking, positive, proactive
